citation: Minetti G, Dorn I, Kofeler H, Perotti C, Kaestner L. Insights from lipidomics into the terminal maturation of circulating human reticulocytes. Cell Death Discov. 2025;11(1):79. PMID 40016214; doi:10.1038/s41420-025-02318-x
what_it_supports: Five-stage RY-RM-EY-EM-EO lipid trajectory; PC saturated/monounsaturated species decrease while polyunsaturated species increase; PE short/saturated species increase while long/polyunsaturated species decrease; SM species with <20C amidated chains increase and >=20C decrease; PS species with the longest/most unsaturated chains decrease; VPS13A declines from reticulocytes to old erythrocytes; CD71 disappears in the first week
evidence_note: MECHANISM CAVEAT: the authors state that reticulocytes and erythrocytes cannot perform de novo phospholipid synthesis and attribute remodelling to selective lipid removal and/or exchange with plasma, with possible involvement of VPS13A. A gene-to-acyl-chain regulatory bridge is therefore a hypothesis in this cell type, not an established mechanism.

citation: Guillou H, Zadravec D, Martin PGP, Jacobsson A. The key roles of elongases and desaturases in mammalian fatty acid metabolism: Insights from transgenic mice. Prog Lipid Res. 2010;49(2):186-199. PMID 20018209; doi:10.1016/j.plipres.2009.12.002
